_comments.security: NO secrets in this file. GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN is read from the environment (exported by bin/mr-review.js from the macOS keychain). IMPORTANT: the GitLab PAT currently committed inline in kiro-powers/gitlab-mr-review/mcp.json MUST be revoked in GitLab > Settings > Access Tokens and replaced with a least-privilege (read_api + api-for-comments) token stored in the keychain.
_comments.guardrail: The mr-reviewer agent's allowedTools list grants ONLY read tools + the two comment-post tools (create_merge_request_thread / create_merge_request_note). create_merge_request, merge, and approve are intentionally NOT granted. autoApprove below still lists only comment/read tools so nothing else can auto-run.
_comments.loading: Posting does NOT use MCP — review_post.py posts over REST+PAT. The GitLab MCP server is now optional: the agent uses its READ tools only to pull sibling-service MRs during a review, and falls back to the Jira context if they're absent. If you do want it, the server runs 'npx -y @zereight/mcp-gitlab', so node+npx must be on the PATH of the launching process (verify 'command -v npx node'; a GUI-launched session often differs from your terminal). Keep the server name 'GitLab' matching the agent's @GitLab/* grants, and reference ${GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN} rather than an inline token.
